question:
In the following Venn diagram, the square represents 'creative people', the hexagon represents 'painters', and the triangle represents 'people who live in rural areas'.

Select the option which represents the number of creative painters who live in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de793dff39c07bd7318ce8919e662ffdc1c728b5f2ccf43fa1c502224b2102d2.png]
solution:
• The shaded part represents the number of creative painters who live in rural areas..

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3390ef06244752402178b3323b57edfdea3fcca3ca8b2c8bed7a34ced22a9eb8.png] 

 
• The number representing the number of creative painters who live in rural areas = 2

**Hence, ‘option 3’ is the correct.**
